title: Stop the lead reading files through Bash cat, sed and grep
body:
Outcome: lead file reads through Bash cat, sed -n and grep fall by half per merged PR.
Why: those three families return 7.1 MB, 54% of the lead's 13.2 MB Bash results since 2026-11-01, and every byte is re-read from cache on each later turn (.krn/runs/roadmap-refill/token-per-slice.md, section 6); krn-lead says to delegate reading but nothing enforces it.
Proof: a PreToolUse rule or an output cap with a test, then token-scan.py section 6 on new sessions.
Scope: scripts/claude hooks, krn-lead skill, tests.
